title: CouncilLens analysis artifact
description: The output of the analyse stage for one council + topic: a plain-English summary of every document (with AI provenance) and the feedback -> decision -> outcome linkages, each labelled with a linkage tier. Strict: unknown fields are rejected so the analyse output stays as disciplined as the canonical record it is built from.

council.description: Council name, carried through from the processed manifest.

topic.description: The single topic this analysis covers.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the analyse logic that produced this artifact. Lets cached outputs be invalidated when the logic changes.

prompt_version.description: Version of the summarisation spec used. Part of every AI output's provenance (see methodology).

coverage.description: How many documents sit at each stage. A zero in feedback/decision/outcome is the 'still waiting' signal residents need.

sha256.description: Content hash of the source document this summary was built from. Ties the summary to an exact input.

summary.description: A plain-English summary plus the provenance every AI output must carry (methodology: source IDs, prompt version, model, review flag, timestamp).

method.description: 'ai' = drawn from the versioned, human-reviewed cache. 'extractive' = deterministic fallback (lead sentences), not yet AI-summarised or reviewed.

model.description: Model name/version that produced an 'ai' summary, or the deterministic method id for an 'extractive' one. Recorded as provenance only — the build never calls a model live.

review.description: approved = a person checked it (required before publishing). pending = AI output awaiting review. auto-extractive = deterministic draft needing an AI + human pass. no_text = nothing to summarise yet.

generated_at.description: When the summary was produced. For extractive drafts this is the source document's fetch time, keeping the build a pure function of its inputs.

linkage.description: One feedback->decision or decision->outcome relationship, labelled with a tier. We never assert causation beyond what the records show.

tier.description: confirmed = the later record cites the earlier source. possible = same topic, configured stage roles, but no citation found. none = nothing to link to.

symbol.description: Resident-facing label for the tier: confirmed/possible/none.

reason.description: Plain-English explanation of why this tier was assigned.

evidence.description: What the tier is based on, so a reviewer can check it.

review.description: Linkage assertions are human-reviewed before publishing (methodology). Defaults to pending.
